name: Keyboard Improved
summary: Word suggestions as you press each key
description: The stock XT9 keyboard, with the same words, suggestions and keys, but responsive: a letter shows its suggestions when the key goes down instead of when it is released, usually within two screen refreshes. Space and the other keys respond about four times faster too.
author: thooton

changes.text: Speed up the phone's own XT9 engine library.
Catalog description says two refreshes, as measured.
XT9 suggestions within two frames of each key press.
